name: Spiral
description: A reverb whose tail is carried by gliding voices an octave apart under a bell of level, so it climbs or sinks for as long as it rings and never arrives.

params.name: Climb
params.description: How fast the tail glides in pitch. Above the centre it climbs, below it sinks, and at the centre it comes to rest in tune with what is played.

params.name: Decay
params.description: How long the tail rings after the sound that fed it stops.

params.name: Size
params.description: The size of the space the tail rings in. Small is tight and coloured, large is loose and slow to gather.

params.name: Voices
params.description: How many octaves are stacked in the tail. Two stays near the played pitch and lets each hand over to the next octave be heard, six reaches far below and above.

params.name: Spread
params.description: How wide the bell of level over pitch is. Narrow lets one voice lead so the glide is pure, wide lets all the octaves sound together.

params.name: Tone
params.description: The brightness of the tail. Lower settings take the highs away, and they die sooner the longer the tail rings.

params.name: Blur
params.description: How far the gliding voices are smeared into a wash. Low keeps each voice distinct and grainy, high melts them into one cloud.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far apart the tail's two sides stand. At 0 they are the same; turned up they part in phase, a quarter turn at most, and the tail loses at most 3 dB summed to mono.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the gliding tail.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. A feedback delay network feeds six delay-line pitch voices an octave apart that glide together under a bell of level over pitch, then a chain of allpasses.
